operations.description: Persists configuration only. Runtime settings are applied at process startup when the notification runtime is enabled; saving does not enable or reload a provider.

fields.name: mail_secret
fields.description: Official mail service credential (DirectMail AccessKeySecret or SendGrid API key) for value.mail_provider. Omitted keeps the stored one; required when choosing an official provider whose credential is not stored.

fields.name: smtp_password
fields.description: SMTP password in plaintext, stored encrypted under the control-api credential keyring and never returned. Omitted keeps the stored one, an empty string clears it. A stored password cannot coexist with value.smtp_password_reference; sending both is refused (smtp_password invalid), and a reference while a password stays stored is refused (value.smtp_password_reference invalid).
fields.description_zh: SMTP 明文密码，用 control-api 凭据钥匙串加密保存，从不回显。省略保留原值，空串清除。已存密码与 value.smtp_password_reference 不能同时存在：两者同时填写被拒（smtp_password invalid），保留已存密码时填写引用被拒（value.smtp_password_reference invalid）。

fields.name: sms_auth_token
fields.description: HTTPS SMS gateway token (sms_provider https_json) in plaintext, stored encrypted under the control-api credential keyring and never returned; at runtime it replaces NOTIFICATION_SMS_AUTH_TOKEN. Omitted keeps the stored one, an empty string clears it. Refused for aliyun/submail (they use sms_access_key_secret). A stored token cannot coexist with value.sms_access_key_reference; sending both is refused (sms_auth_token invalid), and a reference while a token stays stored is refused (value.sms_access_key_reference invalid).
fields.description_zh: HTTPS 短信网关（sms_provider 为 https_json）的明文令牌，用 control-api 凭据钥匙串加密保存，从不回显；运行时替换 NOTIFICATION_SMS_AUTH_TOKEN。省略保留原值，空串清除。阿里云/SUBMAIL 不接受（它们用 sms_access_key_secret）。已存令牌与 value.sms_access_key_reference 不能同时存在：两者同时填写被拒（sms_auth_token invalid），保留已存令牌时填写引用被拒（value.sms_access_key_reference invalid）。

operations.summary: Send a test mail with the provider on the page
operations.summary_zh: 用当前页面的邮件服务发送测试邮件
operations.description: Sends one test mail through value.mail_provider without saving anything, so a provider can be checked before switching. An official provider uses mail_secret or, only for the same provider, the stored credential; SMTP uses the page's SMTP fields with the stored SMTP password (smtp_password_configured), filling gaps from NOTIFICATION_SMTP_* only under smtp_tls/smtp_starttls; what is still missing comes back as 422 system_mail_settings_config_incomplete with details.missing. A send the provider refused or that could not be made is 502 system_mail_settings_test_failed with details.reason; only a sent mail is 200. The attempt is audited without the credential.

responses.description: The provider accepted the test mail.

system_mail_settings_validation_error: the body is not valid JSON or has unknown fields, value or mail_secret is refused, or the recipient is refused. A missing or empty to is details {field: to, reason: required}; a to that is not one plain mail address (no display name, at most 254 characters) is details {field: to, reason: invalid_format}. Nothing was sent.
responses.description_zh: system_mail_settings_validation_error：请求体不是合法 JSON 或含未知字段、value 或 mail_secret 无效，或收件人无效。to 缺失或为空时 details 为 {field: to, reason: required}；to 不是单个纯邮箱地址（不带显示名、最长 254 个字符）时 details 为 {field: to, reason: invalid_format}。未发送。

responses.description: system_mail_settings_config_incomplete: the SMTP sender still lacks fields; details.missing names them as save body fields (value.smtp_address, value.smtp_user, smtp_password, value.smtp_from). Nothing was sent.
responses.description_zh: system_mail_settings_config_incomplete：SMTP 发信还缺字段，details.missing 按保存请求体路径列出（value.smtp_address、value.smtp_user、smtp_password、value.smtp_from），未发送。

responses.description: system_mail_settings_test_failed: the provider refused the mail or could not be reached; details.reason is the stable code: config_invalid, credential_rejected, sender_rejected, recipient_rejected, provider_rate_limited, provider_unavailable, provider_rejected, provider_response_unknown, tls_required, or a plugin error code.

system_mail_settings_test_unavailable: the notification runtime is forced off (NOTIFICATION_RUNTIME_ENABLED=off); unset, auto or false turn it on at start when this page holds a complete sender. system_mail_settings_unavailable: settings storage or policy is unavailable.
